performance_concern.name: Kiosk Echo handler has NO debounce for CatalogChanged — bulk admin toggle triggers N XHR refetches
performance_concern.scenario: Admin uses Mission 1 V2 unified browser to toggle 10 sauces off in 1 minute. With concurrency=2 + 100ms gap, that is 10 toggles in ~600ms wall-clock = 10 Echo broadcasts arriving back-to-back on the kiosk. Each fires KioskAppComponent.vue:765-767 fetchMenu({force:true}) → 10× GET /api/frontend/menu in ~1-2s. Each one Cache::forgets before refetch (per listener order — Cache::forget runs SYNCHRONOUSLY in the listener chain, ahead of the broadcaster job). Worst case: 10 cache rebuilds + 10 XHR returns, each ~150ms first-hit. Per-kiosk CPU/bandwidth blip; if 5 kiosks subscribe to same branch channel that's 50 XHRs concentrated in 2s. NOT a correctness defect — eventual consistency holds and the final state is correct.
performance_concern.evidence: KioskAppComponent.vue:745-770 (no debounce) vs StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue:478-482 + L290-296 (admin side IS debounced 500ms — asymmetric)
performance_concern.fix_estimate: Tiny — wrap _handleCatalogChanged in lodash debounce or vanilla setTimeout coalescer with 500-800ms window (matches admin side). Pattern already exists in KioskAppComponent.vue:642-647 _scheduleStaleToast (800ms debounce on offline conflict toasts). Could also coalesce with _handleCatalogChangeMidSession which is already orchestrated by useCatalogChangeNotifier composable.
performance_concern.track_as: P3 V1.0.X polish — V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-store + ~1 kiosk + occasional bulk-toggle (chef runs out of 3 sauces, not 10) makes this latent. Becomes RED if owner ever ships franchise multi-location with simultaneous bulk catalogue rebuilds.

sub_areas.name: Failure cascade — Echo broadcast fails (Pusher/Soketi down)
cascade_trace: Step 1 — Cache invalidation succeeds locally: InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged.php:45-78 runs synchronously in the listener chain, completes BEFORE the broadcaster job is queued. Server-side kiosk.menu.branch.{id} IS flushed regardless of Echo health.

Step 2 — Outbox row persisted: PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:71-91 firstOrCreate happens INSIDE the original DB transaction (afterCommit closure). The DomainEvent row IS persisted before broadcaster dispatch.

Step 3 — Broadcast dispatch wrapped in try/catch: PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:104-117 — DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch wrapped in try { ... } catch (\Throwable $broadcastException) — failure ONLY logs Log::warning, does NOT bubble. AvailabilityController returns 200 OK to admin.
Step 4 — Kiosk does NOT get Echo event: handler never fires → kiosk in-memory menu state stays stale

Step 5 — Recovery layer 1: Cron foodking:outbox:rescue (Kernel.php:40-43 everyMinute + onOneServer) re-queues outbox rows where attempts<5 and dispatched_at IS NULL. If broadcaster recovers within ~5 min, the event arrives late but arrives.
Step 6 — Recovery layer 2: Cron foodking:outbox:retry-failed (Kernel.php:64-69 hourly + --since=24h) handles terminal failures past Phase 1 retries (attempts>=5).
Step 7 — Recovery layer 3: Cron foodking:outbox:monitor --threshold=10 (Kernel.php:50-53 everyMinute) raises Log::error + non-zero exit when >=10 rows accumulate undispatched → pages operator.

Step 8 — Kiosk-side graceful degradation: NO active polling fallback for /api/frontend/menu in kioskMenu.js — the kiosk relies on either (a) Echo + Cache::forget propagation or (b) the 60s server-side cache TTL natural expiration. ΔT degrades from ~1s to ~60s + listener-replay delay (still <= ~120s worst case).

Step 9 — Customer-facing safety: even if kiosk shows stale availability for 60s+, the backend AvailabilityService rejects any order POST against an unavailable item (422). KioskCartComponent.vue:652 pre-flight pruneUnavailableLines call fires once the next /api/frontend/menu returns fresh data (cache miss = fresh refetch). So worst-case UX is 'item visible in wizard for 60s, then disappears OR Valider rejects with prune toast' — degraded UX, NOT broken correctness.

performance_concern.name: Kiosk has NO active menu polling fallback when Echo is unhealthy
performance_concern.scenario: Soketi container crashes during a service window. Admin toggles items via Mission 1 dashboard. Cache::forget runs locally on the Laravel side, server-side TTL expires every 60s, BUT kiosks already have items[] loaded in Vuex memory and NEVER refetch unless: (a) user navigates back to category landing page, (b) the page reloads, (c) Echo recovers and a NEW broadcast arrives. In a steady-state idle kiosk on the wizard step, the customer could see an unavailable item highlighted for several minutes.
performance_concern.evidence: kioskMenu.js:259-344 fetchMenu only triggered by external dispatch (initial app boot, Echo handlers, setBranch). grep for setInterval near fetchMenu in kioskMenu.js → 0 hits. No background poll. KioskAppComponent.vue setInterval calls (L347 syncCb 15s, L999 healthcheck) cover offline queue + browser tab health, NOT menu freshness.
performance_concern.fix_estimate: Add a low-frequency safety-net poll: e.g. setInterval(() => store.dispatch('kioskMenu/fetchMenu', {force:false}), 120_000) — relies on getters.isStale 5min TTL OR force=true with 5-min cadence. Cost: 1 XHR per kiosk every 2-5min as belt-and-suspenders for Echo outage. Already pattern: KioskWaitingComponent.vue:168/L294 uses POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15s for order status polling.
performance_concern.track_as: P3 V1.0.X — V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne with Soketi colocated on same Hetzner box has very low blast radius. Becomes P2 the day a SaaS franchise ships with remote Pusher dependency.
performance_concern.v1_safety: Bounded by 60s server-side cache TTL (next refetch after wizard transition fetches fresh data). Backend availability guard prevents incorrect orders.

sub_areas.verdict: AMBER — recovery layers exist for Laravel-side outbox AND backend cache holds correct state, but kiosk client has no active poll fallback for menu (only event-driven). Static-only finding — degraded UX, no correctness defect
